sections.body: NYJ kicker J.Sanders has made 21 [kc1] of 24 [kc2] field goal tries, but only 66.7% [kc4] on 6 [kc5] attempts from 50-plus yards, so a long NYJ try is a real miss risk. Their punts have a net average of 41.9 yards [kc6] against BUF's 43.2 yards [kc8], so expect field position to stay close. NYJ kickoffs are touchbacks 21.3% [kc10] of the time, and special-teams EPA is 0.02 per play [kc15], ranking 13th [kc17]. Trust a field goal only on makeable kicks, and keep kickoffs deep rather than giving returners short starts.

sections.heading: Injuries and availability
sections.body: NYJ's latest report lists WR Garrett Wilson as Out [ic1] with a concussion. He has drawn 24.4% of team targets [ic2], so expect that volume to go to backups and shallower looks. DE Joseph Ossai is also Out [ic4] with an ankle injury. CB Nahshon Wright, LB Trevin Wallace and S VJ Payne are also Out, and DT Harrison Phillips is Questionable. BUF's latest report lists WR Josh Palmer as Out [ic7], a minor loss at 5.4% of team targets [ic8]. OT Dion Dawkins is Questionable [ic10] with a rib injury after playing 99.3% of snaps [ic11] in 7 games [ic12], so his status is the key pass-protection check.

sections.heading: Key matchups
sections.body: The biggest matchup is pass protection against the blitz. NYJ sends five or more rushers on 38.8% of dropbacks [mc1] and has a pressure proxy of 16.0% [mc2], while BUF allows 15.4% [mc4]. If Dawkins sits after averaging 99.3% of snaps [mc5], keep backs and tight ends in and use quick throws. Second, the ground game: NYJ allows positive plays on 43.8% of carries [mc6], while BUF gains them on 46.7% [mc8], so establish early-down runs. Third, finishing drives: NYJ allows touchdowns on 68.8% of red-zone drives [mc11], so score touchdowns rather than settle for field goals. Fourth, NYJ's passing game without Wilson, who drew 24.4% of targets [mc13]. Expect shorter throws, with an average depth of target of 7.5 yards [mc15]. NYJ uses pre-snap motion on 50.2% of plays [mc17], so settle coverage rules before the snap.
